description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases within a dataset, categorized into three distinct groups. The largest segment, colored red, represents entries with no reference answer or test case, accounting for 39.2% of the total. The blue segment, labeled "Have reference answer," constitutes 38.9% of the dataset. The green segment, representing entries with a test case, makes up 21.9% of the total. The chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions of these categories, with the red and blue slices being the most prominent and nearly equal in size, while the green slice is noticeably smaller. A legend in the top-left corner provides a key for the categories: red for "Null (549,238)", blue for "Have reference answer (543,935)", and green for "Have test case (306,818)", with the corresponding percentages displayed directly on the chart.
